name: Espressif ESP32-S3-EYE
mpn: ESP32-S3-EYE (main board ESP32-S3-EYE-MB v2.2 + ESP32-S3-EYE-SUB v1.1)
description: ESP32-S3 AI dev board with a 2 MP OV2640 camera, 1.3-inch LCD on a stacked sub-board, microphone and accelerometer.

specs.label: Module
specs.value: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 (ESP32-S3R8), 8 MB octal PSRAM, 8 MB flash

specs.label: Audio / sensors
specs.value: I2S MEMS microphone (61 dB SNR), QMA7981 3-axis accelerometer

specs.label: Interface
specs.value: Micro-USB (power + USB on GPIO19/20), microSD slot, Wi-Fi + BLE 5

specs.label: Power
specs.value: 5 V USB or 3.7 V Li-ion via solder points (1 A charger)

envelope.axes: x = main board width, y = main board length (camera end at the top); z = stack height not published

features.label: Main board
features.value: 30.00 × 60.00 mm; camera-end notch 18.00 mm wide × 6.40 mm deep, leaving 6.00 mm tabs each side

features.label: Sub board (LCD)
features.value: 30.00 × 31.90 mm, stacks on the main board via J8/J9 headers and FPC J5

features.label: Camera position
features.value: Not dimensioned; scaled from the drawing the lens is on the board centerline about 10.8 mm below the notched end (approximate, verify with the DXF)

features.label: Mounting holes
features.value: None dimensioned on the official drawings (two round features in the top tabs are not called out)

notes: Espressif publishes 2D outlines (PDF + DXF) but no board STEP. Stack thickness and the camera's exact position are not dimensioned. Amazon listing title verified; it appears out of stock.
